Running arbitrary code at install time with network I/O to a remote host is a common backdoor/exfiltration pattern. Combined with missing provenance (empty author, no repo) and an attacker-controlled endpoint, this is deliberate, risky and malicious behavior.

This is client-side data exfiltration to a remote endpoint with no user consent or legitimate configuration, behavior consistent with malicious telemetry/C2. Indicators: getWhoami + getWebhook returning webhook.site and postPayload issuing an HTTP(S) POST. The intent is clearly to send identifying information off-host, so classify as Malware.
